title: About the Author
text: ABOUT THE AUTHOR J.R. BLACKWELL T. KINGFISHER , also known as Ursula Vernon, is the author and illustrator of many projects, including the acclaimed horror novel The Twisted Ones and the webcomic Digger , which won the Hugo Award for Best Graphic Story and the Mythopoeic Award. Her work The Tomato Thief won the Hugo Award for Best Novelette, and her short story “Jackalope Wives” won the Nebula Award for Best Story. She is also the author of the bestselling Dragonbreath and the Hamster Princess series of books for children. Find her online at RedWombatStudio.com .
